# Lief Builders

> Owner's Rep, Project Advocacy and Oversight. Built. Different.

## URL
https://liefbuilders.com

## What We Are
Lief Builders provides owner's representation, project advocacy, and construction oversight services. With over 100 years of combined expertise, we advocate for property owners in construction projects, insurance claims, and project management. We put experienced professionals on your side so contractors and insurers cannot take advantage of what you do not know.

## Services

### Owner's Representation and Project Advocacy
Construction oversight and advocacy for property owners. Experience includes disaster recovery rebuilds (Greensburg, Kansas tornado; Santa Barbara fire damage) and luxury residential projects. Every engagement is customized to the scope the project demands.

### Insurance Claim Navigation
Navigating insurance claims to maximize recovery for property owners.

### Project Management and Oversight
Faster builds, tighter budgets, and zero surprises. Full-scope project management and construction oversight.

Arizona, Southern California, and other markets where owners need experienced advocacy.
